meta.down_from: fitted: the mean direction of 14 ropes from their LED spacing (spread 4.4 deg rms)
meta.lens: multi-view map lens: f 1056.1 px, k1 -0.5363
meta.rope: 0-based, as in the pixel map (rope 1 of the rope map = 0); LED 0 = the plug end
meta.heights: metres above the floor (the lowest decoded LED of a "floor" rope = 0), rounded to cm; consistent across ropes, not exact; scales with cam_height_m
meta.methods: floor: own lowest LED is the floor; pitch: distance from the LED pitch; given: --rope-distance-m; neighbours: median distance of its two nearest ropes; borrowed: the map missed it, heights of its nearest rope
meta.pool_from: first LED from the plug end at or below pool_height_m (400 = none); LEDs from there on are the pool
meta.xy: show view (the gallery cam's home view, as the people counter sees it): 0..1 from the top left
meta.tilt_deg: how far a screen's top leans from vertical as seen from the camera, + = to the right
meta.eddies_note: runs at or below the pool line dropped (the coils lie across the logs)
